name: The City
description: (Tag:growing)(Tag:machine)(Tag:production)(Tag:summon)(Tag:tech)(Tech) The City is a Dyson-sphere-origin megastructure of hyper-compressed defensive and computational layers, factories, cities, and terminals holding millions of impossibly advanced technologies and blueprints.
